description: An open educational platform established by the European Association of Clinical Pharmacology and Therapeutics (EACPT) to facilitate international collaboration and sharing of online prescribing-education resources.
title: EurOP²E — the European Open Platform for Prescribing Education

description: A European Commission framework that defines digital competence through five competence areas and progressive proficiency levels for citizens and educational assessment.
title: European Commission's Digital Competence Framework (DigComp)

description: The EGeMSE is a UEMS-GMS examination developed with the British Geriatrics Society and the UK Royal Colleges to assess theoretical geriatric-medicine knowledge in doctors in training and qualified specialists.
title: European Geriatric Medicine Specialty Exam (EGeMSE)

description: A UEMS-developed framework defining adaptable minimum competency and training standards for postgraduate medical specialist education in Europe.
title: European Training Requirements (ETR) framework
